transcript: Speaker A: Do cup chai ka kitna hua? [How much for two cups of tea?] Speaker B: That would be 24 rupees, since each cup of tea is 12 rupees. Speaker A: Oh achha. UPI lete ho kya? [Oh, okay. Do you accept UPI?] Speaker B: Yeah sure, you can pay using UPI. Speaker A: Tumhari English toh bahut achhi hai. YouTube dekh ke seekhi kya? [Your English is very good. Did you learn it by watching YouTube?] Speaker B: Nahi, English seekhne ke liye practice karni hoti hai. YouTube pe practice kaise karunga? [No, to learn English you need to practice. How will I practice on YouTube?] Speaker A: Haan, baat toh sahi hai. Phir kahan se seekhi? [Yes, that's true. Then where did you learn it from?] Speaker B: Ek app hai MySivi karke, usmein ek AI teacher hai jiske sath main practice karke English seekhta hoon. [There is an app called MySivi, it has an AI teacher with whom I practice and learn English.] Speaker A: Oh achha. Par yeh app toh mehenga hoga na? [Oh, okay. But this app must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: Bilkul nahi. Maine bas 1 rupee mein shuru kiya tha and sabse best part hai ki yahan agar kharab English bolo toh koi judge nahi karta, bas galtiyan sudhar di jaati hain. [Not at all. I started for just 1 rupee and the best part is if you speak bad English here, no one judges, they just correct your mistakes.] Speaker A: Are wah! Phir toh sab logon ko yeh app use karna chahiye. [Oh wow! Then everyone should use this app.] Speaker B: Bilkul. [Absolutely.] Voiceover: Download MySivi app now.
on_screen_text: MySivi English speaking app Install Now. 3 days of Premium benefits for Rs 1. 24/7 AI Teacher, 500+ Exercises and Lessons, Unlimited Access.
summary: An office worker is impressed by a tea delivery boy's fluent English. The boy explains that he practices speaking with an AI teacher on the MySivi app, which corrects his mistakes without judgment. The ad highlights a 3-day premium trial for just 1 rupee.
